name: Mech Defenderz
summary: Mech Defenderz puts you in the cockpit of a giant robot. Slash with your saber, blast with your buster and rifle, and raise your shield as waves of enemy mechs, warships and bosses attack. Battle through stunning cities, forests, storm-lashed oceans, asteroid belts and deep space, then bring the fight into your own room with a Mixed Reality bonus level. The world needs a defender. Suit up, pilot.  Defeat the enemy robots.
